svg.title: How a new account is created
svg.desc:
How a new account is created States shown: Live, Being built, Planned. Solid lines: data flows today. Dotted lines: connection to build.
Blocks, left to right: - Sign-up form - Check details - Create account - Send welcome email - Set up profile (being built) - Start free trial (planned) - Ready to use Groups: - Account service: Create account, Send welcome email, Set up profile, Start free trial Lines: - Sign-up form -> Check details - Check details -> Create account, labeled "valid" - Check details -> Sign-up form, labeled "try again" - Create account -> Send welcome email - Create account -> Set up profile - Create account -> Start free trial (connection to build) - Send welcome email -> Ready to use - Set up profile -> Ready to use - Sign-up form -> Ready to use
